scripts.dev: npm run build -w @remote-learning/domain && concurrently -k -n domain,next,vite,angular -c yellow,cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @remote-learning/domain" "npm run dev -w react-next" "npm run dev -w react-vite" "npm run start -w @remote-learning/angular"
scripts.dev:react-next: npm run build -w @remote-learning/domain && npm run dev -w react-next
scripts.dev:react-vite: npm run build -w @remote-learning/domain && npm run dev -w react-vite
scripts.dev:angular: npm run build -w @remote-learning/domain && npm run start -w @remote-learning/angular
scripts.test: npm run build -w @remote-learning/domain && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
